```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
cfg <- params$config
s <- yaml::read_yaml(params$summary)
st <- cfg$structure
png_of <- function(files) grep("\\.png$", files, value = TRUE)
show_images <- function(files) {
  pngs <- png_of(files)
  if (length(pngs) == 0) {
    cat("Add `png` to `plots.formats` to see the figures here. Files:\n\n")
    cat(paste0("- `", files, "`"), sep = "\n")
  } else {
    for (f in pngs) cat(sprintf("![%s](%s)\n\n", basename(f), f))
  }
}
```

## Data

- Input file: `r s$input_file` (`r s$input_format`)
- **`r s$n_individuals` individuals**, **`r s$n_loci` loci**, `r s$n_populations` populations (level: `r s$pop_level`)
- Strata: `r paste(s$strata, collapse = " / ")`
- Missing data: `r s$missing_data_percent`% of allele calls

```{r pop-table}
pops <- data.frame(
  population = names(s$individuals_per_population),
  individuals = unlist(s$individuals_per_population),
  row.names = NULL
)
knitr::kable(pops)
```

## STRUCTURE settings

- K = `r st$k_min` to `r st$k_max`, `r st$replicates` replicates per K (`r (st$k_max - st$k_min + 1) * st$replicates` runs)
- Burn-in `r format(st$burnin, big.mark = ",")`, MCMC repetitions after burn-in `r format(st$numreps, big.mark = ",")`
- Model: `r if (isTRUE(st$model$admixture)) "admixture" else "no admixture"`,
  `r if (isTRUE(st$model$freqscorr)) "correlated" else "independent"` allele frequencies,
  LOCPRIOR `r if (isTRUE(st$model$locprior)) "on" else "off"`
- Seeds: run seed = `r st$seed` + 1000 × K + replicate

<details><summary>mainparams / extraparams</summary>

```{r params-files, comment = ""}
cat(readLines(params$mainparams), sep = "\n")
cat("\n")
cat(readLines(params$extraparams), sep = "\n")
```

</details>

## Choosing K

```{r lnprob}
lnp <- utils::read.delim(params$lnprob)
knitr::kable(lnp, digits = 2)
```

```{r evanno-table}
ev <- utils::read.delim(params$evanno)
knitr::kable(ev, digits = 3)
```

```{r evanno-plot, results = "asis"}
show_images(params$evanno_plots)
```

## CLUMPAK modes

For each K, CLUMPAK groups the replicate runs into modes. The plots show the
**major mode**. Many minor modes, or a major mode with few runs, suggest that the
runs disagree: check them, or use longer runs.

```{r modes}
knitr::kable(utils::read.delim(params$modes), digits = 3)
```

## Plots

```{r plots, results = "asis"}
plots <- params$plots
groups <- list(
  "Single K" = grep("/plots/single/", plots, value = TRUE),
  "Range of K" = grep("/plots/range/", plots, value = TRUE),
  "Maps" = grep("/plots/maps/", plots, value = TRUE)
)
for (nm in names(groups)) {
  files <- groups[[nm]]
  if (length(files) == 0) next
  cat("\n\n### ", nm, "\n\n", sep = "")
  show_images(files)
}
```

All result files are in `results/`r cfg$project`/`:
`q/` (Q tables, also as Excel), `plots/`, `evanno/`, `clumpak/` (full CLUMPAK output), `structure/runs/` (raw STRUCTURE output).

## Software and citations

```{r versions}
pkgs <- c("adegenet", "poppr", "hierfstat", "pophelper", "ggplot2", "scatterpie")
v <- vapply(pkgs, function(p) as.character(utils::packageVersion(p)), "")
knitr::kable(data.frame(software = c("R", "STRUCTURE", "CLUMPAK", pkgs),
                        version = c(R.version$version.string, "2.3.4", "26_03_2015", v)))
```

Please cite: Pritchard et al. (2000) and Falush et al. (2003) for STRUCTURE;
Kopelman et al. (2015) for CLUMPAK; Evanno et al. (2005) for ΔK;
Francis (2017) for pophelper; Mölder et al. (2021) for Snakemake.
